name: Fortune Seeker
notes: Spoil logic (all bands): Spoil first, packs with Spoil Bomb / Spoil Festival, then AoE, then Sweeper on every spoiled corpse before picking up drops.
Open question: corpse time for sweeping on L2Toggle.
The 76-85 table lists only the changes: the Bounty Hunter rows it does not replace are kept below (why: "kept from the 40-75 Bounty Hunter table").

rows.trig: Attack: auto-attack (dagger or blunt). No damage skills in this band.
Self-heal: Bandage (was excluded from the extract) out of combat only.
Then Hammer Crush (blunt, stun) in the gaps (blunt only).
Armor Crush (opener: stun plus defense x0.7), then Crushing Strike, then Fatal Strike.
Then Crushing Strike (to 5704 power at 85).
Then Fatal Strike.
AoE: packs of 3+: Spoil Bomb (79+: up to 12 targets in r200, 80 % rate, 15 s reuse) first, then Earthquake, then Whirlwind.
Packs of 3+: after Spoil Bomb, Earthquake (polearm, 8 s), then Whirlwind.
Packs of 3+: then Whirlwind.
Riposte Stance: off for DPS.
Parry Stance: off for DPS. Parry on only when tanking a pack with HP < 40 %.
Braveheart (CP +1000) in PvP or against CP-damaging bosses.
Never: Symbol of Resistance (manual).
Never: Wrath.

rows.trig: Spoil logic 1: spoil the target before it dies, ideally as the first action (magic land chance, 40 range). If it says "spoil failed", retry once or twice while the mob has > 30 % HP. Skip low-value mobs. In a party the spoiler spoils while the others hold their attacks for about 1 s, or the spoiler opens the pull.
rows.why: kept from the 40-75 Bounty Hunter table / spoil logic

rows.trig: Spoil logic 3: sweep every spoiled corpse right after the kill, before picking up drops (drops stay on the ground longer than corpses). Make sweep priority 1 the moment a spoiled mob dies; corpses last about 7 s on L2J, longer for spoiled ones [?]. 0.5 s reuse, 20 range, needs a corpse.
rows.why: kept from the 40-75 Bounty Hunter table / spoil logic

rows.trig: Sweep 2+ spoiled corpses at once (Sweeper Festival 444; checked in game 2026-10-26: Spoiler16 has it learned on L2Toggle). One corpse: Sweeper 42.
